title: Gusangiza amakuru yawe
intro: Mbere y'uko porogaramu igira icyo yerekana, banza usome uko amakuru yawe akoreshwa.
summaryWhatBody: Ibisubizo n'intambwe zikurikira itsinda rikuvura ryasuzumye rikabikugezaho, kwibutswa kwawe n'uko byagenze.
summaryWhoBody: Wowe, cyangwa ukuhagarariye mu mategeko, kuri iki gikoresho. Itsinda rikuvura ribika amakuru yawe ku kigo nderabuzima.
summaryWithdrawBody: Igihe icyo ari cyo cyose: Ibindi → Uburenganzira → Hagarika gusangiza. Porogaramu ihita ihisha byose.
noticeBody1: Iri ni igerageza. Abantu bose n'amakuru byose ni ibihimbano. Nta makuru nyayo akusanywa cyangwa yoherezwa ahandi.
noticeBody2: Porogaramu yerekana gusa amakuru itsinda rikuvura ryakugejejeho. Ntijya isuzuma indwara cyangwa itanga inama zo kwivuza.
noticeBody3: Buri gihe amakuru yawe arebwe, birandikwa kugira ngo uzabibone nyuma.
conflict: Uburenganzira bwawe bwahinduriwe ahandi. Dore ibigezweho.
saveError: Uburenganzira bwawe ntibwashoboye kubikwa. Nta cyahindutse. Ongera ugerageze.
noRecordBody: Itsinda rikuvura ntirirahuza amakuru y'ubuzima n'iyi konti. Ibyo bikorwa uri kumwe na bo ku kigo nderabuzima. Nta kintu kigaragara mbere y'icyo gihe.
withdrawnBody: Wahagaritse gusangiza. Itsinda rikuvura riracyafite amakuru yawe; iyi porogaramu ntikiyerekana.
confirmBody: Porogaramu irahita ihagarika kwerekana ibisubizo byawe, intambwe zikurikira, kwibutswa n'uko byagenze, kandi kwibutswa kwateguwe guhagarikwa. Amakuru yawe yo kwa muganga ntasibwa — itsinda rikuvura riracyayafite. Ushobora kongera gutanga uburenganzira igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
withdrawError: Gusangiza ntibyashoboye guhagarikwa. Nta cyahindutse. Ongera ugerageze.
